item.title: India offered sanctuary to Iranian ship three days before US sank it
item.summary: India says Tehran sought permission to dock three ships on the day the US and Israel began a war on Iran.

item.title: Australia urged to protect Iran women's football team as they prepare to fly home
item.summary: Concern has grown for team after one critic called them 'wartime traitors' for failing to salute during the Iranian anthem.

item.title: Who is Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran's new supreme leader?
item.summary: Many expect the 56-year-old, who has largely kept a low profile, to continue his father's hardline policies.

item.title: War fuels debate in Cyprus over UK military bases
item.summary: “British Bases Out” is the slogan of Cypriot protesters after a drone strike targeted the RAF Akrotiri airbase.

item.title: Explosion at US embassy in Oslo may have been terrorism, Norway police say
item.summary: Police say they are investigating other motives after the blast caused minor damage to the embassy building.

item.title: Alleged Bondi gunman seeks order to suppress family's identity
item.summary: Naveed Akram is seeking to prevent media publishing details about his mother, sister and brother.

item.title: Police release images of Oslo US embassy explosion suspect
item.summary: Norwegian police say their investigation so far shows Sunday's blast was caused by an improvised device.

item.title: Guinea opposition leader urges 'direct resistance' after 40 parties dissolved
item.summary: Cellou Dalein Diallo accuses the junta-leader-turned-president of erasing political threats.

item.title: Rihanna's Beverly Hills home hit by gunfire, police say
item.summary: A suspect was arrested after the shooting on Sunday afternoon, Los Angeles officers say.

item.title: Australians must prove they are over 18 to access porn under new laws
item.summary: Sites such as Pornhub and RedTube must verify the ages of all users or risk million-dollar fines.
